comments.content: The error message interpolates the entire `person` object instead of `person.id`. When `person` is undefined this will log `undefined`, and when it exists it will dump the whole object. Use `person?.id` for a useful message.

The error message references `asset.originalPath` but the actual failure is that the asset has no preview file. The message is misleading; consider including the asset id or clarifying that the preview is missing.

`getById` returns `this.db...executeTakeFirst() ?? null`, but `executeTakeFirst()` already resolves to `undefined` when no row exists, and the `?? null` is applied to the Promise (which is always truthy), so it never converts to `null`. The previous code had the same bug, but since this PR is touching the method, it would be good to fix it by awaiting the query before applying `?? null`.

`mapFaces` now inlines the fields from `mapFacesWithoutPerson` instead of spreading it. This duplicates the field mapping and risks divergence if `mapFacesWithoutPerson` changes. Consider keeping the spread and only overriding `person`.
